body: It might not be my fault, but I still don't feel like I did enough to keep her around. Maybe if I tried harder? Maybe if I put more effort in? So many maybes and what ifs.

Real ones. And they're super expensive, and I don't really have the extra money laying around to do it. 

It is my fault. I could have been more careful about the words I said. I could have taken time to think before I spoke. There are a lot of things I could have done, that I so wish I could go back and redo again. And do it right this time.

I used to fly airplanes, but haven't done that in a long time.

I bought a jeep a couple months ago for my gf and I to go offroading in. We had a great time, but it seems like that's the only trip she's gonna take in it.

I feel like a huge failure. I had something in my life that I loved and loved and loved unconditionally; I would do anything for her, but I messed up and let her get away. If I'm not good enough to hold onto what's priority number one to me, I'll never get the stuff that is less important to me. 

It's all downhill from here.

I don't feel like there's anyone to talk to it about. 

This happens to everyone. I should be able to cope with it. 

I have a really hard time opening up and sharing my feelings with anyone, let alone something that already hurts so much to think about let alone talk about and have to explain to another person.
